notes: Chart rule: content win[1..6] already matched the packet chart, so full sides moved alone with rating+why in the same atomic group; phases[6].rating left at 7/10 (already fits a Viktor verdict — a no-op edit would be rejected). Report cap: lint flagged four report entries for pronouns (report[3], report[4], report[9], report[11]) but the sweep allows at most two report rewrites — I fixed report[3] and report[9]; report[4].t ('his tower') and report[11].t ('his optimal range') still carry a misgendered 'his' and need a later pass or a cap exemption. missingInteractions your-channel-punished (her E cancels your R channel) not written: Riot's R text mentions no channel, likely flag misfire, could not verify. resistances-invalidated (true damage from P/W upgrades) is real per kit text but I found no same-length field to ground it without expansion; noted here.
